preprocessingAndLocalDatabaseGraphs.plannedMethods:
Planned methods (review before use; this describes the selected analysis, not completed results):

Step S1 (Prepare the explicitly selected local database) will be performed using python 3.13.16 (pack kraken2 1.0.0). A local Kraken2 nucleotide database resource will be registered by validating the binary index layout and hashing its exact hash.k2d,opts.k2d and taxo.k2d bytes. Source/provider/release will be explicitly recorded. Optional Bracken distributions will be hash-pinned with an explicit user attestation of database/read-length/model-settings association. No classification, download or database construction is performed. Settings: Database label=Synthetic check; Database source/provider=Deterministic fixture; Database release/date=2026-10-04; Bracken model association=no. Inputs: Existing database hash.k2d: I1 · Existing database hash.k2d.

Step S2 (Filter paired reads and retain surviving unpaired reads) will be performed using fastp 1.3.7-reportfix1; paircheck 1.0.1 (pack fastp 0.4.1). Trim known adapters and paired-read overlaps; sliding-window tail trimming with explicit quality/length/N filters. Poly-G trimming and duplicate estimation are disabled. Orphans and failures are retained. Settings: Trimming / alignment workers=2; Read 1 3' adapter=AGATCGGAAGAGC; Read 2 3' adapter=AGATCGGAAGAGC; Tail-window mean quality=20; Tail-window size=4; Minimum retained read length=35; Qualified base Phred score=15; Maximum low-quality bases (%)=40; Maximum N bases per read=5. Inputs: Paired reads: I2 · Paired reads.

Step S3 (Classify cleaned read pairs as fragments) will be performed using python 3.13.16 (pack kraken2 1.0.0). Kraken2 2.17.2 will classify validated Phred+33 DNA FASTQ against the selected local nucleotide database, with SHA-256 identity of its minimizer index, taxonomy and options to be verified before and after execution. Confidence, minimum hit groups, base-quality threshold, threads and memory access mode will be recorded. No quick mode or read trimming will be applied. Mates will be validated for identity/order/count and classified jointly; report counts describe fragments. Ordinary six-column reports, per-fragment minimizer evidence, observed read lengths, commands and input hashes will be retained. Classification proportions include unclassified input and are not Bracken abundance estimates. Database provenance is user-supplied and does not prove suitability or clinical identification. Settings: Classification threads=2; Confidence threshold=0; Minimum hit groups=2; Minimum Phred+33 base quality=0; Database access=mapped. Inputs: Read 1 FASTQ: S2 · Filter paired reads and retain surviving unpaired reads → Trimmed paired reads | Registered Kraken2 database: S1 · Prepare the explicitly selected local database → Kraken2 database descriptor.

Step S4 (Classify surviving unpaired read 1 observations) will be performed using python 3.13.16 (pack kraken2 1.0.0). Kraken2 2.17.2 will classify validated Phred+33 DNA FASTQ against the selected local nucleotide database, with SHA-256 identity of its minimizer index, taxonomy and options to be verified before and after execution. Confidence, minimum hit groups, base-quality threshold, threads and memory access mode will be recorded. No quick mode or read trimming will be applied. Each input read will be classified independently. Ordinary six-column reports, per-fragment minimizer evidence, observed read lengths, commands and input hashes will be retained. Classification proportions include unclassified input and are not Bracken abundance estimates. Database provenance is user-supplied and does not prove suitability or clinical identification. Settings: Classification threads=2; Confidence threshold=0; Minimum hit groups=2; Minimum Phred+33 base quality=0; Database access=mapped. Inputs: Reads FASTQ: S2 · Filter paired reads and retain surviving unpaired reads → Passing read 1 with rejected mate | Registered Kraken2 database: S1 · Prepare the explicitly selected local database → Kraken2 database descriptor.

Step S5 (Review separately attributed Kraken reports) will be performed using Combine statistics reports (pack builtin 0.5.0). Collect selected statistics into a local HTML report with a separate, attributed section for each input. Counts are not pooled and variant files are not merged. Settings: Report title=Pipeline report. Inputs: Statistics to include: S3 · Classify cleaned read pairs as fragments → Six-column Kraken2 report; S4 · Classify surviving unpaired read 1 observations → Six-column Kraken2 report.

Tool references:
Wood DE, Lu J, Langmead B (2019). Improved metagenomic analysis with Kraken2. Genome Biology20:257. https://doi.org/10.1186/s13059-019-1891-0

Planned methods (review before use; this describes the selected analysis, not completed results):

Step S1 (Prepare the explicitly selected local database) will be performed using python 3.13.16 (pack kraken2 1.0.0). A local Kraken2 nucleotide database resource will be registered by validating the binary index layout and hashing its exact hash.k2d,opts.k2d and taxo.k2d bytes. Source/provider/release will be explicitly recorded. Optional Bracken distributions will be hash-pinned with an explicit user attestation of database/read-length/model-settings association. No classification, download or database construction is performed. Settings: Database label=Synthetic check; Database source/provider=Deterministic fixture; Database release/date=2026-10-04; Bracken model association=no. Inputs: Existing database hash.k2d: I1 · Existing database hash.k2d.

Step S2 (Filter paired reads and retain surviving unpaired reads) will be performed using fastp 1.3.7-reportfix1; paircheck 1.0.1 (pack fastp 0.4.1). Trim known adapters and paired-read overlaps; sliding-window tail trimming with explicit quality/length/N filters. Poly-G trimming and duplicate estimation are disabled. Orphans and failures are retained. Settings: Trimming / alignment workers=2; Read 1 3' adapter=AGATCGGAAGAGC; Read 2 3' adapter=AGATCGGAAGAGC; Tail-window mean quality=20; Tail-window size=4; Minimum retained read length=35; Qualified base Phred score=15; Maximum low-quality bases (%)=40; Maximum N bases per read=5. Inputs: Paired reads: I2 · Paired reads.

Step S3 (Classify cleaned read pairs as fragments) will be performed using python 3.13.16 (pack kraken2 1.0.0). Kraken2 2.17.2 will classify validated Phred+33 DNA FASTQ against the selected local nucleotide database, with SHA-256 identity of its minimizer index, taxonomy and options to be verified before and after execution. Confidence, minimum hit groups, base-quality threshold, threads and memory access mode will be recorded. No quick mode or read trimming will be applied. Mates will be validated for identity/order/count and classified jointly; report counts describe fragments. Ordinary six-column reports, per-fragment minimizer evidence, observed read lengths, commands and input hashes will be retained. Classification proportions include unclassified input and are not Bracken abundance estimates. Database provenance is user-supplied and does not prove suitability or clinical identification. Settings: Classification threads=2; Confidence threshold=0; Minimum hit groups=2; Minimum Phred+33 base quality=0; Database access=mapped. Inputs: Read 1 FASTQ: S2 · Filter paired reads and retain surviving unpaired reads → Trimmed paired reads | Registered Kraken2 database: S1 · Prepare the explicitly selected local database → Kraken2 database descriptor.

Step S4 (Classify surviving unpaired read 1 observations) will be performed using python 3.13.16 (pack kraken2 1.0.0). Confidence, minimum hit groups, base-quality threshold, threads and memory access mode will be recorded. No quick mode or read trimming will be applied. Each input read will be classified independently. Ordinary six-column reports, per-fragment minimizer evidence, observed read lengths, commands and input hashes will be retained. Classification proportions include unclassified input and are not Bracken abundance estimates. Database provenance is user-supplied and does not prove suitability or clinical identification. Settings: Classification threads=2; Confidence threshold=0; Minimum hit groups=2; Minimum Phred+33 base quality=0; Database access=mapped. Inputs: Reads FASTQ: S2 · Filter paired reads and retain surviving unpaired reads → Passing read 1 with rejected mate | Registered Kraken2 database: S1 · Prepare the explicitly selected local database → Kraken2 database descriptor.

Step S5 (Review separately attributed Kraken reports) will be performed using Combine statistics reports (pack builtin 0.5.0). Collect selected statistics into a local HTML report with a separate, attributed section for each input. Counts are not pooled and variant files are not merged. boundaries: Native installation checks use the released Workbench bridge/importer and scientific runner. Graph tests use a Python publication copy callback; biological executables and native importer are exercised separately.

Large databases and read-length distributions are external resources. Hashes bind bytes, but distribution-to-database association remains explicitly user-attested. Analysis performs no implicit network download.

Paired classification counts fragments. Bracken standard-model settings and exact read lengths are checked; variable-length use requires explicit representative-length approximation. Its denominator is int(sum of unrounded retained estimates), not all sequenced reads or cell abundance.
